item.title: Air Fryer Nachos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Tortilla chips - 150–200g
  • Cheese - 1.5–2 cups (cheddar or blend)
  • Sweet corn - 1/2 cup
  • Bell peppers - 1 cup (chopped)
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)
  • Jalapeños (optional)

Seasoning

  • Oregano
  • Chilli flakes
  • Salt (optional)

Optional Add-ons

  • Cooked beef or chicken
  • Beans
  • Sour cream
  • Guacamole
  • Salsa

Directions

  1. Line air fryer basket with parchment paper
  2. Add a layer of tortilla chips
  3. Top with vegetables, corn, and cheese
  4. Repeat layers if needed (chips → toppings → cheese)
  5. Sprinkle oregano and chilli flakes
  6. Air fry at 180°C for 5–7 minutes until cheese melts
  7. Remove and add optional toppings (sour cream, salsa, etc.)
  8. Serve immediately

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 30g

Notes

  • Confirmed structure from reel + standard air fryer method :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Best eaten fresh — chips soften quickly after cooking :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Easily adaptable with added protein for a full meal

item.title: Big Mac Toastie
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Bread slices - 4
  • Ground beef - 300g
  • Cheese - 4 slices
  • Pickles - to taste
  • Onion - 1/4 (finely diced)
  • Lettuce - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Butter - 1 tbsp

Big Mac Sauce

  • Mayonnaise - 3 tbsp
  • Ketchup - 1 tbsp
  • Mustard - 1 tsp
  • Pickle juice - 1 tsp
  • Paprika - pinch

Directions

  1. Cook ground beef in a pan, breaking it up and seasoning with salt and pepper
  2. Mix all Big Mac sauce ingredients in a small bowl
  3. Butter the outside of the bread slices
  4. On the inside, layer beef, cheese, pickles, onion, lettuce and sauce
  5. Close sandwich and cook in a pan or sandwich press until golden and crispy
  6. Slice and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 680
  • Protein - 38g
  • Carbs - 42g
  • Fat - 38g

Notes

  • Corrected from previous misclassification (was incorrectly labelled as a chicken wrap)
  • Classic fast-food style toastie — high calorie, high fat

item.title: Chili Garlic Noodles
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ground pork - 1/2 lb
  • Oil - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 6 cloves (minced)
  • Onion - 1/4 (finely chopped)
  • Noodles - 300g
  • Seasoning
    • Garlic powder - 1 tsp
    • Salt - 1/2 tsp
    • Pepper
    • Chilli flakes
  • Sauce
    • Soy sauce
    • Chilli oil
    • Brown sugar

Directions

  1. Cook the noodles and set aside
  2. Heat the oil in a pan and cook the ground pork until browned
  3. Add the garlic and onion and cook until fragrant and softened
  4. Season with garlic powder, salt, pepper and chilli flakes
  5. Stir through soy sauce, chilli oil and a little brown sugar
  6. Add the cooked noodles and toss well to coat
  7. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 430 per serving
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 44g
  • Fat - 15g

Notes

  • Sauce quantities were reconstructed from the visible reel ingredients and usual noodle ratios

item.title: Feta Fried Egg Tortilla
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Egg - 1
  • Feta cheese - 2 tbsp (crumbled)
  • Tortilla - 1 small
  • Avocado - 1/4 (sliced)
  • Chilli oil - drizzle (optional)

Directions

  1. Sprinkle feta in a circle in a hot pan
  2. Once it starts melting, crack the egg into the centre
  3. Place tortilla on top and press down gently
  4. Cook until the egg sets and feta crisps
  5. Flip so tortilla side is down and toast briefly
  6. Remove, top with avocado and chilli oil
  7. Fold and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 380
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 28g
  • Fat - 22g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed recipe content :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Very fast, high-flavour breakfast or snack
  • Texture comes from crispy feta + soft egg contrast

item.title: Garlic Butter Jalapeño Popper Croissants
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Jalapeños - 6 (halved, deseeded)
  • Cheddar cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Croissant dough - 1 tube
  • Butter - 2 tbsp (melted)
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Parsley (optional)

Directions

  1. Slice jalapeños in half and remove seeds
  2. Fill each with shredded cheddar cheese
  3. Wrap each jalapeño with croissant dough
  4. Mix melted butter with garlic and brush over wrapped poppers
  5. Bake at 180°C for 15–20 minutes until golden
  6. Garnish with parsley and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 420
  • Protein - 12g
  • Carbs - 28g
  • Fat - 28g

Notes

  • Originally misclassified as a chicken caesar bowl — corrected based on reel content
  • High-fat, indulgent snack rather than high-protein meal

item.title: Hash Brown Feta Bites
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Hash browns (frozen or shredded potato) - 400g
  • Feta cheese - 150g (crumbled or cubed)
  • Egg - 1
  • Flour or breadcrumbs - 2 tbsp (optional, for binding)
  • Oil spray or drizzle
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Garlic powder
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. If using frozen hash browns, thaw slightly
  2. Mix hash browns with egg, seasoning, and optional binder
  3. Form small portions and press feta into the centre (or mix feta through)
  4. Shape into balls or patties
  5. Place on a lined tray and lightly spray with oil
  6. Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy
  7. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 340
  • Protein - 12g
  • Carbs - 30g
  • Fat - 20g

Notes

  • Confirmed as a feta + hash brown bite-style recipe
  • Likely variations include coating feta in hash browns or mixing through
  • Good as a snack, side, or brunch item

item.title: Loaded Breakfast Wrap
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Large wraps - 2
  • Eggs - 4
  • Bacon - 4 rashers
  • Cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Hash browns - 2
  • Spinach or greens (optional)
  • Sauce (optional)
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook bacon until crispy, then set aside
  2. Cook hash browns until golden
  3. Scramble eggs in the same pan
  4. Layer eggs, bacon, hash browns, cheese, and greens into wraps
  5. Fold tightly into burrito shape
  6. Toast in pan until golden and crispy on the outside
  7. Slice and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 26g

Notes

  • Identified based on user verification
  • Typical “loaded breakfast wrap” structure (eggs + bacon + potato + cheese)
  • Good for quick breakfasts or meal prep

item.title: Pizza Cupcakes
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Biscuit dough (canned) - 1 can
  • Pizza sauce - 1/4 cup
  • Mozzarella cheese - 1/2 cup (shredded)
  • Pepperoni - 8–10 slices
  • Butter - 2 tbsp (melted)
  • Garlic - 1 tsp (minced)
  • Italian seasoning

Directions

  1. Flatten biscuit dough and press into muffin tray to form cups
  2. Add pizza sauce, cheese, and pepperoni into each cup
  3. Mix melted butter with garlic and brush over dough edges
  4. Sprinkle with Italian seasoning
  5. Bake at 180°C for 12–15 minutes until golden
  6. Remove and serve warm

Macros

  • Calories - 350
  • Protein - 12g
  • Carbs - 30g
  • Fat - 20g

Notes

  • Previously misclassified as a chicken rice bowl — corrected based on reel content
  • More of a snack/appetizer than a main meal

item.title: Spicy Peanut Dumplings
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Frozen dumplings - 12 to 16
  • Spring onion - 2 sprigs
  • Peanut butter - 2 tbsp
  • Red curry paste - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 1 tsp minced
  • Ginger - 1 tsp minced
  • Soy sauce - 1 tbsp
  • Sesame oil - 1 tsp
  • Coconut milk - 1/2 cup
  • Chicken stock - 1/2 cup

Directions

  1. In a baking dish, mix together the peanut butter, red curry paste, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, coconut milk and chicken stock
  2. Add the frozen dumplings to the sauce
  3. Bake until the dumplings are cooked through and the sauce has thickened
  4. Top with sliced spring onion and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 360 per serving
  • Protein - 13g
  • Carbs - 36g
  • Fat - 18g

Notes

  • Macros are estimated from a 4-serving batch
